parameters.query: INSERT INTO jc_notes (text, source) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING id, status, text;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ String($('Called by workflow').first().json.arg1 || '').trim().slice(0, 4000), String($('Called by workflow').first().json.arg2 || '') ] }}

parameters.query: SELECT id, to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE '__JC_TZ__', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS d, status, closed_note, text FROM jc_notes WHERE status <> 'deleted' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 400;

UPDATE jc_notes SET text = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), text), status = CASE WHEN $3 IN ('open','closed') THEN $3 ELSE status END, closed_note = CASE WHEN $3 = 'closed' THEN NULLIF($4, '') WHEN $3 = 'open' THEN NULL ELSE closed_note END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int AND status <> 'deleted' RETURNING id, status, text;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ (() => { let o = {}; try { o = JSON.parse($('Called by workflow').first().json.arg2 || '{}') } catch (e) {} return [ String(parseInt($('Called by workflow').first().json.arg1, 10) || 0), String(o.text || ''), String(o.status || ''), String(o.closed_note || '') ]; })() }}

parameters.query: UPDATE jc_notes SET status = 'deleted', updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int AND status <> 'deleted' RETURNING id, status, text;
